headline: Italians are cashing in their money, and banks may win big again
summary: Investors continue to back leading Italian banks despite higher special taxes. Earnings are supported by growth in fee and commission income, sector consolidation and a rising interest rate environment.
why: Italy's large listed banks are core constituents of the FTSE MIB and a key barometer of European financial stocks and sovereign credit sentiment.
